Total Elapsed Damage is (Sting Time ÷ Tick) × Bee Damage. In cases where Sting Time ÷ Tick results in a number that is not a full number, such as 7.33, it should be rounded down, in the previous example that being 7.
DPS assumes that only one enemy is currently being stung and only one stack is applied. It is calculated as (Damage ÷ Firerate) + (Bee Damage ÷ Tick)
How much DPS is added every second through it applying bee stacks. It is calculated as (Bee Damage ÷ Tick) ÷ Firerate
DPS when every single stack is applied for one
. It is calculated as (Damage ÷ Firerate) + [(Bee Damage ÷ Tick) × Stack Limit]
